levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الملك بن أبي الشوارب

notes: «ح» joins two isnads with no «قالا» or «جميعا»: the first ends at أبو معاوية and names nothing after it; the second writes its own names to Aisha
The first isnad is read as written, not completed with Asim al-Ahwal, although the second route passes through him
